resample_order_experiment.concern: gee/ndvi_change.js::atAnalysisScale calls resample('bilinear') on derived images, including collection medians. Earth Engine documents that resample requires a meaningful default projection and warns against applying it to composites.
resample_order_experiment.expected_observation: A composite has no meaningful default projection, so order-1 (composite -> resample) may resample against a default rather than the source grid. Order-2 (resample -> composite) resamples each source image on its own projection.
possible_outcomes: identical values: the concern does not bite for this collection/AOI
differing values: compositing order changes the delivered grid; record magnitude
an Earth Engine error on order-1: record as an OBSERVED FAILURE, do not edit the live helper during closeout
